item.title: King Charles III speaks to world leaders in Antigua, expresses 'sorrow' over slave trade
item.description: King Charles III has called the transatlantic slave trade a “shameful chapter of history” during a speech at the official opening of the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Antigua.

item.title: Conservation group to sue over Kodiak, Gulf salmon management
item.description: The Wild Fish Conservancy has sent notice to the Alaska Department of Fish and Game and NOAA Fisheries it intends to sue over management of sport and commercial salmon fisheries in Kodiak, Chignik and Alaska Peninsula waters, alleging violations of the Endangered Species Act.

item.title: Taco Bell sales recover in the US after summer cyclospora outbreak
item.description: Taco Bell’s U.S. sales are climbing again after a cyclospora outbreak tied to the chain slowed visits over the summer.
